146202.overview: Cassette 10: Winter Sports features two skiing games: ski jumping and slalom. Ski jumping uses both a side-view and a perspective birds-eye view to display the action. In the side view the skier can be seen going down the ramp and in the birds-eye view, the landing is witnessed. Different game settings have different wind behavior. The slalom game has no settings. The goal is to move the skier through the various gates.
